recipe.name: Heloderma — the beaded one / Delft clay
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Procedural half-round, two-part Delft clay, Z=0 parting on the crest line. The Gila's beadwork: tall domed beads in the black bands, low beads in the salmon bands, square pavers under the palm, a graded row of bare gypsy mounds down the spine and a 3 mm spessartite flush-set in the swell's top mound. At the bench: drill the raised dot and cut the flush seat, set the stone; deepen the bead lands on the flanks with a 0.06 mm graver; polish the high beads, leave the lands satin.
